title: fancy the ancy in fields of pansies Dancing Nancy's twirling smiles whilring for miles I can see the chance he fancied in frenetic shandies. #smallpoe
summary: fancy the ancy in fields of pansies Dancing Nancy's twirling smiles whilring for miles I can see the chance he fancied in frenetic shandies. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
fancy the ancy
in fields of pansies
Dancing Nancy's
twirling smiles
whilring for miles
I can see
the chance he
fancied
in frenetic shandies.
#smallpoems
